description: This file defines a custom Request class extending Symfony's HttpRequest within the OrangeHRM system. It adds deprecated warning handling for parameter retrieval and a static method for creating a request object from global variables, with special handling for authorization headers.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A custom extension of Symfony's HttpRequest with additional handling for deprecated get method and global request creation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides the parent get method to include a deprecation warning and special debug behavior in development mode.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Request class from PHP's global variables, with extra handling for authorization headers.
